svg.title: Mill-type hydraulic cylinder – section with seals, cushioning and ISO 6099 mounting codes (example)
svg.text: Mill-type double-acting cylinder – longitudinal section (example bore 63 / rod 36, ISO 6020-1 / ISO 6022 class)
Heads bolted to flanges on a thick tube → 16 / 25 MPa, easy repair. Accent red = dynamic seals (wear parts). Scale ≈ 2.6 px/mm, stroke shortened.
rod: chrome 20–25 µm, Ra 0.1–0.3 µm, f7
cap (rear head), port A = piston side
ISO 6099 mounting codes (sketch) – the mounting decides the buckling length L_k = K · L
Push load: MF1 front flange gives the shortest L_k. Pivot mountings (MP, MT) need spherical bearings at both ends. Buckling: Euler F_k = π² E I / L_k², S ≥ 3.5.
Standards and example series (check the catalogue)
Rexroth CDH1 / CDH2 / CDH3, Parker HMD (check)
